description: Public/static backend registry schema for Mimir AI. Do not store secrets here. Runtime/private endpoints should be added by the user in the portal and kept in localStorage or provided by a protected backend later.

backends.name: OCI VM — Open WebUI (example)
backends.notes: Example OCI VM backend running Open WebUI over Ollama. Replace URL with your actual instance.

backends.name: Local Ollama (example)
backends.notes: Example local Ollama backend. Only accessible from the same machine or LAN. Not reachable from deployed GitHub Pages.

backends.name: Railway API proxy (example)
backends.models: depends on backend provider configured in Railway
backends.notes: Example Railway-hosted connector proxy. Secrets are stored in Railway environment variables, not here. Replace URL with your deployed service. See docs/ai/connector-template/ for the template.

backends.name: Codespaces dev backend (example)
backends.models: any model the dev container can reach
backends.notes: Example GitHub Codespaces backend for development and testing only. Replace MY_CODESPACE with your actual Codespace name.
